purpose: Privacy-safe QRFY command catalog for non-mutating-intent Windows Recovery Environment diagnosis after a failing-disk preservation workflow.

preservation_contract.strict_preservation_requires: hardware/controller write protection or another independently proven Windows-side read-only mechanism before volume/filesystem access

privacy_contract.notes: Repository commands and classifications are reusable; machine-specific output stays local or in the operator's private evidence store.

commands.purpose: Confirm that the current recovery shell is Windows cmd.exe before sending Windows-native probes.
Read volatile firmware/baseboard identity exposed by WinRE without traversing the source filesystem.
Inventory current physical-disk rows and retained volume objects before any source-volume access.
Resolve the intended volume to its current-session DiskPart backing-disk number without filesystem traversal.
Re-query the exact current-session disk number resolved from the intended source volume; failure to select/detail it is source-specific absence evidence.
Supplement DiskPart with currently connected disk-class PnP devices without intentionally traversing a source filesystem.
Inspect BitLocker state only after hardware/controller or independently proven Windows-side source write protection exists.
Inspect the assigned volume GUID only after source write protection is independently proven.

commands.command: for %d in (C D E F G H) do @if exist %d:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM echo WIN=%d:
commands.purpose: Look for an accessible offline Windows SYSTEM hive only after source write protection is independently proven.
Traverse the source filesystem only after source write protection is independently proven.

transition_rules.proof_boundary: A retained source-volume object without a current backing-disk association cannot authorize source-volume access or repair.
Other WinRE or USB disks may remain present; only the intended source volume's resolved backing-disk locator controls this classification.

when.directory_probe_result: A device which does not exist was specified.

transition_rules.collection_gate: Do not reproduce this symptom by directory traversal unless source write protection is independently proven; treat it as supporting evidence only when already observed.

systemrescue_handoff.source_ro_semantics: If the recovery workflow intentionally used blockdev --setro, a later Linux RO=1 observation is expected host protection and is not by itself proof of a controller-enforced read-only failure.
required_before_winre: recovery destination and image artifacts verified
read-only image mount stack cleanly detached
source returned to protected read-only state before SystemRescue shutdown
recovery destination disconnected before Windows repair
systemrescue_handoff.winre_preservation_limit: Linux block-layer read-only state does not survive reboot. The WinRE QRFY catalog avoids explicit write commands but is not a media write blocker.
systemrescue_handoff.winre_identity_rule: Re-resolve the intended source volume to a current-session DiskPart disk number on every WinRE boot; never carry disk numbers across boots and never let unrelated recovery-media disks satisfy source presence.
systemrescue_handoff.winre_write_gate: Do not authorize source-volume access or write-capable repair until the intended source disk is currently present through the source-volume binding and strict preservation, when required, is enforced by hardware/controller protection or another independently proven Windows-side read-only mechanism.
